gui.eminus.settings.title: Eminus Settings
gui.eminus.settings.ingestion.hint: Convert the chunks you see into LOD. With it off, nothing new reaches the store.
gui.eminus.settings.lod_quality.hint:
How much detail LOD keeps.

Ultra: 1 block per voxel, every detail.
High: 1 block per voxel; opaque leaves, no grass or flowers.
Medium: 2 blocks per voxel, about a seventh of the store.
Low: 4 blocks per voxel, textures at half resolution.
Minimal: 8 blocks per voxel, textures at half resolution.
Custom: your own voxel size, see-through leaves, grass and flowers and texture resolution, set with Custom Settings... beside the slider.
gui.eminus.settings.custom_lod.hint: Set the four values Custom uses, one by one. Available when LOD quality is Custom.
gui.eminus.settings.custom_lod.title: Custom LOD Quality
gui.eminus.settings.custom_lod.nearest_v: How many blocks one voxel covers at LOD's nearest edge. Each step up stores LOD coarser. Changing this reads the chunks around you again.
gui.eminus.settings.custom_lod.leaves.hi:
ON: leaves in LOD keep their holes at every distance.
OFF: leaves in LOD draw solid.
The game's See-Through Leaves option does not change LOD. The leaf faces inside a canopy show only where a voxel is 1 block.
gui.eminus.settings.custom_lod.grass_and: Draw grass, ferns, flowers and saplings in LOD. Off leaves them out.
Full: 16×16 texels on each block face.
Half: 8×8 texels on each block face.
gui.eminus.settings.far_render_cells.hin: How far LOD reaches. Work grows with the square of this distance: more meshes walked each frame, and more of them in video memory.
gui.eminus.settings.worker_threads.hint: Background threads that build LOD. Higher catches up faster and competes harder with the game's own chunk builders; lower is the other way round.
gui.eminus.settings.detail_distance.hint: How far out the finer detail of LOD reaches. Each step up doubles that distance and costs more video memory. A higher screen resolution reaches further at the same step.
gui.eminus.settings.detail_distance.limi: Not reached right now: the geometry arena is full, so LOD is drawn coarser than this setting asks.
gui.eminus.settings.fog.hint: Fog over LOD, carried on from the game's own fog and full at the LOD distance. Off also clears the open-air fog from the loaded chunks, so the whole view stays clear. Fog in the Nether, from a boss, under water or from blindness stays.
gui.eminus.settings.fade.hint: Fade LOD out over its last 512 blocks instead of ending it in a hard line.
gui.eminus.settings.shader_pack_lod.hint: How LOD is drawn under a shader pack without Eminus support. Default draws it over the pack's image in Eminus's own look. Distant Horizons lets a pack that supports Distant Horizons draw it with the pack's light and fog, but one flat colour per block. A pack made for Eminus always draws LOD itself. Changing this reloads the shader pack.
gui.eminus.settings.lod_animations.hint: Lets a shader pack made for Eminus sway grass, leaves and water in LOD, as it does nearby. Turning it off saves the GPU time this costs. Changing this reloads the shader pack.
